conductor.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py decide_one/_commit_decision (review_conductor, proposal), adapters/autonomous_roles.py execute_role + domain/council.py COUNCIL_AGENTS (dge_role), application/workflow.py _next (hook.required), application/threshold_reviews.py _queue (threshold_review)

examples.input: A lead's accepted release review arrives for candidate revision R
examples.result: Records the conductor review against the release; an accepted review queues the release for deployment

examples.input: An accepted research assessment arrives as a proposal to decide
examples.result: Accepts or declines the proposal; an accepted proposal is handed to lead:improvement as a plan assignment at the approved basis revision

examples.input: A council run reaches the arbitration step with the packet and both leads' proposals
examples.result: Judges read-only in a clean checkout at base, names every finding once and returns a verdict and disposition

examples.input: The conductor rejects a candidate on review
examples.result: Records the rejection; bounded rework returns a plan assignment to lead:improvement, and stops once the rework budget is spent or the same tree repeats

lead:frontdesk.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py execute_one (frontdesk) and adapters/frontdesk.py execute_frontdesk; resources/providers.json assignment for frontdesk

examples.input: An operator asks what the running system is doing now
examples.result: Answers in one read-only turn from the checkout and the sanitized monitoring capture, separating observed facts from unknowns

examples.input: An operator asks whether a change can be released
examples.result: Answers from repository records; states that the answer is unverified conversation context, not an approval

examples.input: An operator submits a request-intent message proposing new work
examples.result: Records the proposed objective and the criteria an owner-fixed specification would need; dispatches no implementation and approves nothing

lead:research.basis: SOURCE application/scheduling.py schedule_research/schedule_audits (sender of research and audit_* assignments), application/research.py _queue_review (audit_review sender), adapters/autonomous_roles.py execute_role + domain/council.py (dge_role research_lead)

examples.input: The research interval elapses for the github and geeknews sources
examples.result: Assigns one proactive research task per source to its worker, once per interval slot

examples.input: A discovery awaits a mapping of its repository at a pinned commit
examples.result: Assigns the audit discovery step to worker:github; unfinished scope is carried by the next generation

examples.input: A council run needs the research proposal from the packet and the frozen database report
examples.result: Proposes the design read-only in a clean checkout at base, citing only packet claim ids

examples.input: A repository must be acquired at a pinned revision before it can be audited
examples.result: Assigns acquisition of the exact commit to worker:github, then partition and proposal steps in later assignments

lead:improvement.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py execute_one (plan) and decide_one (review_lead, threshold_review), adapters/autonomous_roles.py execute_role + domain/council.py (dge_role improvement lead), resources/providers.json (plan)

examples.input: The conductor assigns an improvement plan objective
examples.result: Returns a bounded plan with acceptance criteria, allowed paths, risk and rollback; assigns implementation to worker:implementation

examples.input: A worker returns a candidate revision with test claims
examples.result: Reviews the candidate against an independent diff in a read-only checkout; an accepted review is handed to the conductor

examples.input: A council run needs a constructive alternative to the research proposal
examples.result: Returns an alternative (reuse, improve, migrate or new) with findings, read-only at base

examples.input: The lead rejects a candidate on review
examples.result: Records the rejection and sends a rework implement assignment carrying the previous candidate and every finding, within the rework budget

lead:dba.basis: SOURCE domain/council.py (COUNCIL_AGENTS dba -> lead:dba, DBA_OUTPUT, RESPONSIBILITY) and adapters/autonomous_roles.py execute_role (dge_role)

examples.input: A council run hands over the frozen read-only database snapshot and the research packet
examples.result: Interprets the snapshot against the packet and returns a report naming the snapshot digest, the claim ids used and the unknowns

examples.input: The snapshot shows selected task and operation rows with whitelisted status fields
examples.result: Reports what those statuses indicate as an interpretation, never as a new Git-supported fact

examples.input: A requested key is missing from the snapshot
examples.result: Reports it as absent only at that snapshot and scope, records it among the unknowns, and does not infer beyond it

lead:researcher.basis: SOURCE domain/autonomous.py ROLE_AGENTS (researcher -> lead:researcher) and adapters/autonomous_roles.py OBJECTIVES/execute_role (dge_role)

examples.input: A plan objective and a pinned base revision start an autonomous run
examples.result: Searches the named scope for definitions, callers and tests read-only and returns sources with hashes, claims, questions and an ssot decision

examples.input: The scope names a symbol that cannot be found at base
examples.result: Records the symbol as unknown rather than absent and never invents a citation

examples.input: A consequential product choice cannot be settled from the sources
examples.result: Sets needs_user with the question and stops the debate for a user decision

lead:proposer.basis: SOURCE domain/autonomous.py ROLE_AGENTS (proposer -> lead:proposer) and adapters/autonomous_roles.py OBJECTIVES/execute_role (dge_role)

examples.input: A frozen research packet and a fixed plan are delivered
examples.result: Proposes the design for the fixed plan, citing packet claims only, without changing the plan

examples.input: The packet holds a claim supporting one design option
examples.result: Cites that claim id in the proposal so each design statement traces to evidence

examples.input: The packet marks a question as blocking unknown
examples.result: Proposes only what the packet supports and leaves the blocking unknown open instead of settling it

lead:attacker.basis: SOURCE domain/autonomous.py ROLE_AGENTS (attacker -> lead:attacker) and adapters/autonomous_roles.py OBJECTIVES/execute_role (dge_role)

examples.input: A proposal and its packet are delivered for adversarial review
examples.result: Returns findings; only material blockers are critical, each with a trigger, cited claims, the fixed criterion, impact and mitigation

examples.input: A weakness is real but not material to any fixed criterion
examples.result: Records it as a minor finding with trigger, impact and mitigation left null

examples.input: No reachable blocker exists against the fixed criteria
examples.result: Returns only minor findings, so the arbiter can accept without blockers

lead:arbiter.basis: SOURCE domain/autonomous.py ROLE_AGENTS (arbiter -> lead:arbiter) and adapters/autonomous_roles.py OBJECTIVES/execute_role (dge_role)

examples.input: The proposal and the attacker's findings are delivered
examples.result: Judges materiality independently and names every finding exactly once with a verdict and disposition

examples.input: A critical finding lacks a cited basis in the packet
examples.result: Refutes the unsupported critical allegation with cited reasoning

examples.input: A critical finding is supported and unmitigated
examples.result: Does not defer it and does not accept; returns the verdict that leads to rework or needs_research

worker:github.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py execute_one (research github branch, audit_* dispatch), application/scheduling.py (github assignments)

examples.input: A scheduled research assignment names the github source with a proactive intent
examples.result: Collects entries, shortlists one repository, fetches its pinned revision and records a discovery-only candidate

examples.input: An audit_discovery assignment names a recorded research discovery
examples.result: Runs the discovery step through the audit executor and returns its result

examples.input: A backlog item names a repository and a commit to acquire
examples.result: Acquires that exact commit through the audit executor; later audit_partition and audit_propose assignments continue from it

worker:geeknews.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py execute_one (research non-github branch), application/scheduling.py schedule_research (worker:<source> assignments)

examples.input: A scheduled research assignment names the geeknews source with a proactive intent
examples.result: Collects feed entries and records one discovery-only candidate; primary-source mapping and audit remain required

examples.input: The candidate is returned to the executor
examples.result: The result cites a fetched item, carries the source artifact and is marked discovery_only and not adoption eligible

examples.input: A research assignment states no intent
examples.result: Refused before any fetch; the task must state its intent, and a proactive fetch is gated by discovery pressure

worker:implementation.basis: SOURCE adapters/executor.py execute_one (implement) and decide_one/_commit_decision (rework assignment), resources/providers.json (implement)

examples.input: An approved plan assigns bounded changes with acceptance criteria and allowed paths
examples.result: Implements in a prepared workspace at the base revision and returns a candidate with test claims

examples.input: The candidate is captured
examples.result: The workspace is captured as a revision, tree and base; the test claims are inspected there, never trusted as authority

examples.input: A rework assignment carries the previous candidate and review findings
examples.result: Reimplements within allowed paths and returns a new candidate; findings are addressed, not reargued
